days.title: Volcanic Peaks and Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Trölladyngja
stops.detail: To the north lies the Krýsuvík volcanic system and geothermal area (also spelled Krísuvík), which is also referred to by the name Trölladyngja volcanic system in reference to its central volcano, the shield volcano Trölladyngja, located west of Kleifarvatn.

stops.name: Grænavatn
stops.detail: Several smaller lakes also indicate volcanic origin, such as Grænavatn, a water-filled maar that owes its vibrant color to the diatomaceous earth contained in the water.

stops.name: Seltún
stops.detail: This can be seen in the solfataras of Seltún and another nearby area with hot springs, as well as the solfataras on the mountain slopes of Sveifluháls.

stops.name: Sveifluháls
stops.detail: Furthermore, marked hiking trails lead up the mountain behind it, Sveifluháls, on whose slopes fumaroles can also be seen.
